messages.text: What is OFDM, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

OFDM, as described here, is the waveform/resource structure in which time-domain OFDM symbols and frequency-domain subcarriers form the 5G NR resource grid; a Resource Element is one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol on one antenna port [26][27].
In an OFDM system, a cyclic prefix is added to each time-domain OFDM symbol by copying the last samples of the raw OFDM symbol to its front, creating a guard interval to reduce inter-symbol interference [18].
NR numerology μ determines OFDM symbol duration and subcarrier spacing, and the sample rate is NFFT × SCS = NFFT × 2^μ × 15 kHz [31][23].
| Decision area | Product / option decision | Why OFDM matters | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| WLAN OFDM production/RF testing | On R&S CMW100 K06, choose WLAN generator/analyzer options for OFDM standards: CMW-KW650 for IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n OFDM generation; CMW-KM650/KM651/KM655/KM656/KM657 for WLAN OFDM RF analyzer coverage across 802.11a/g/n/p/ac/ax; choose analyzer bandwidth by standard and MIMO mode/options such as CMW-KM652 or CMW-KM653 [35]. | These options are explicitly for WLAN OFDM generation/analyzers, so the user must understand OFDM standards, bandwidths, and MIMO measurement modes when selecting them [35]. | [35] |
| 5G NR FR1 uplink TX measurement | On R&S CMX500, R&S CMX-KM600 is required for any NR FR1 uplink TX tests; supported measurements include multi-evaluation, PRACH, SRS, and TPC, with NR channel bandwidth 3 MHz to 100 MHz and FDD/TDD, NR standalone, and intraband contiguous EN-DC analysis [13]. | 【推論】Because 5G NR resource mapping is organized by OFDM symbols and subcarriers, and NR numerology determines OFDM symbol duration and SCS, selecting CMX-KM600 measurement settings such as SCS, bandwidth, and uplink signal analysis depends on OFDM concepts [26][31][13]. | [13][26][31] |
| 5G NR generator/analyzer option selection | CMX500 ordering lists R&S CMX-KM600 as the 5G NR analyzer and R&S CMX-KW601 as the 5G NR generator; CMX-KM600 analyzer conditions include FR1, SCS 30 kHz, 16QAM, and 100 MHz bandwidth EVM, while CMX-KW601 generator conditions include 5G NR PDSCH, full allocation, SCS 30 kHz/60 kHz, 64QAM, and 100 MHz bandwidth EVM [12][13]. | 【推論】Because SCS, OFDM symbol duration, and sample rate are coupled in NR OFDM, decisions about CMX500 NR analyzer/generator configuration rely on understanding OFDM numerology and waveform sampling [31][23][13]. | [12][13][31][23] |
| PC-based 5G NR / O-RAN signal analysis | R&S VSE is Rohde & Schwarz PC signal analysis software used for 5G NR, LTE, O-RAN U-Plane/PCAP analysis, and beamforming measurements; listed options include VSE-K144 for 5G-NR DL/UL measurements, VSE-K146 for 5G-NR MIMO & beamforming DL measurements, and VSE-K175 for O-RAN measurements [5][61]. | 【推論】Because 5G NR measurements use the OFDM resource grid and numerology, interpreting VSE 5G NR DL/UL and beamforming measurements depends on understanding OFDM symbols, subcarriers, and SCS [5][61][26][31]. | [5][61][26][31] |

CORESET
[[CORESET]]（Control Resource Set）是 5G NR 中 [[PDCCH]] 所在的 time-frequency resource area，由 frequency-domain RB group bitmap 與 time-domain OFDM symbol duration 定義。

CORESET › REG 編號
依 [[PDCCH (NR)]]，[[Resource Element Group (REG)]] within a CORESET are numbered in increasing order in a time-first manner：

- 從 0 開始。
- 第一個 REG 對應 CORESET 的 first [[OFDM symbol]] 與 lowest-numbered [[Resource Block]]。
- CORESET 中的 REG 總數稱為 `NREG`。

CORESET › REG bundle 與 CCE
CORESET 內的 PDCCH resource hierarchy 為：

- [[Resource Element]]。
- [[Resource Element Group (REG)]]：one RB during one OFDM symbol，含 9 data REs 與 3 DMRS REs。
- [[REG bundle]]：L=2、3 或 6 個 consecutively numbered REGs。
- [[Control Channel Element (CCE)]]：6 REGs。
- [[Aggregation Level]]：一個 PDCCH 使用的 CCE 數。

CORESET › 定義
依 [[PDCCH (NR)]]：

- A CORESET is the area in which PDCCHs are located。
- CORESET 的 dimension 由以下參數定義：
  - `frequencyDomainResources`：bitmap，每個 bit 對應 frequency domain 中一組 6 [[Resource Block]]s。
  - `duration`：1、2 或 3 個 contiguous [[OFDM symbol]]s。

因此 CORESET 同時定義 [[PDCCH]] candidate / allocation 可出現的頻率範圍與時間長度。

R&S VSE
[[R&S VSE]]（Vector Signal Explorer）是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 PC signal analysis software；在 [[R&S portfolio for O-RU testing]] 中用於 5G NR、LTE、O-RAN U-Plane / PCAP analysis 與 beamforming measurements 的分析端。

R&S VSE › unresolved
- [[R&S VSE]] 正式 product page / specifications / release notes 尚未 ingest。
- O-RAN PCAP Converter 的版本與下載來源未由本來源提供。
- VSE 與 [[VIAVI O-RU Tester]] 的整合界面、file workflow 與 timing constraints 未完整描述。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › 文件依據與版次
本頁並列使用兩份來源：

| 來源 | 文件類型 | 文件編號 | 版次 / 軟體 | 日期 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] | Specifications | PD 5216.4127.22 | Version 11.00 | August 2025 | binding specifications、hardware unit 型號、order number、環境、尺寸、電源、service |
| [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] | Features and Functions | 1179.1164.02 | Version 32；CSW 9.20.0 and higher | 來源未標示；© 2026 | GUI、software features、signaling / application / measurement options 與使用介面 |

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合指定 environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。文件區分 specifications with limits、non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 與 uncertainties；non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擔保。

[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 明示：**Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding**。它是 features/functions overview，不是 technical specifications datasheet。

R&S CMX500 › Warranty and service
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]：

- Base unit warranty：1 year。
- All other items warranty：1 year。
- Calibration service plans：up to five years；on demand 為 pay per calibration。
- Warranty and repair service plans：up to five years；on demand 為 standard price repair。
- Extended periods：contact [[Rohde & Schwarz]] sales office。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Spectrum analysis
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM140 提供 spectrum analysis options，包含 frequency sweep measurement（power vs frequency）與 zero span measurement（power vs time）。General settings 包含 external attenuation **-50 dB 至 90 dB**、sweep count **1 至 100**、sweep points **101 至 100001**；frequency sweep RBW **100 Hz 至 10 MHz**，VBW **10 Hz 至 10 MHz**。

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 另提供 FFT spectrum analyzer span 與 FFT length，詳見 ARB 與 FFT spectrum analyzer 章節。

R&S CMX500 › NR FR1

NR cyclic prefix › 基本概念
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- 在 OFDM system 中，CP is added for each OFDM symbol in time-domain。
- CP 是把 raw OFDM symbol 最後幾個 samples 複製到 raw OFDM symbol 前方。
- CP provides a guard interval between two OFDM symbols。
- CP 用於 eliminate inter-symbol interference, ISI。
- NR defines two types of cyclic prefix lengths：[[Normal CP]] 與 [[Extended CP]]。

NR cyclic prefix › Normal CP
[[Normal CP]] 是 normal short length CP：

- 用於 short delay spread environment。
- 14 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- 來源說 standard CP length of most OFDM symbols is 9/128 × NFFT，approximately 7 percent redundancy overhead。
- CP of the first OFDM symbol of every half-subframe is longer than all others，以 compensate inequality。

來源列出的 NCP 標準 CP duration：

| 0 | 66.667 μs | 4.6875 μs | 5.2083 μs | 1406 m |
| 1 | 33.333 μs | 2.3438 μs | 2.8646 μs | 703 m |
| 2 | 16.667 μs | 1.1719 μs | 1.6927 μs | 351.6 m |
| 3 | 8.333 μs | 0.5859 μs | 1.1067 μs | 175.8 m |

NR cyclic prefix › Extended CP
[[Extended CP]] 是 extended longer length CP：

- 用於 long delay spread environment。
- 12 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- CP length is same for all OFDM symbols。
- CP length = NFFT / 4。
- 來源說 this means 25 percent redundancy overhead。
- 來源明示：In NR Release 15 the ECP is only defined for numerology μ=2。

NR cyclic prefix › 與 samples per slot 的關係
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- Samples per subframe S = NFFT × 15 × 2^μ。
- Samples per slot = samples per subframe / slots per subframe = NFFT × 15。
- Useful samples per slot = NFFT × 14 useful OFDM samples。
- CP 對應的 redundant samples distributed over subframe。

當 14 OFDM symbols per slot 時：

- Redundant samples per subframe = NFFT × 2^μ。
- Each slot has total NFFT redundant samples。

當 12 OFDM symbols per slot 時：

- Redundant samples per subframe = 3 × NFFT × 2^μ。
- Each slot has total 3 × NFFT redundant samples。

NR cyclic prefix
[[NR cyclic prefix]] 是 5G NR OFDM symbol 前方加上的 guard interval；[[NR Frame Structure]] 將其分為 [[Normal CP]] 與 [[Extended CP]]。

NR sample rate › Sample rate 公式
來源給出的 NR sample rate calculation：

- Sampling rate in samples/sec = number of samples per raw OFDM symbol / duration of one raw OFDM symbol。
- Sampling rate = NFFT / (1 / SCS)。
- Sampling rate = NFFT × SCS。
- SCS = 2^μ × 15 kHz。
- 因此 sampling rate = NFFT × 2^μ × 15 kHz。

NR sample rate
[[NR sample rate]] 是 5G NR OFDM waveform 中由 NFFT 與 [[Subcarrier Spacing]] 決定的 sampling rate；[[NR Frame Structure]] 以 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] chapter 4.1 的 Tc 定義為起點說明。

NR resource grid › 使用限制
- [[NR Frame Structure]] 未提供 full resource grid formalism，例如 common resource blocks、physical resource blocks、virtual resource blocks、BWP 或 ARFCN mapping。
- Point-A 只以概念文字描述；來源未提供 offsetToPointA、absoluteFrequencyPointA 或 RRC ASN.1 定義。

NR resource grid
[[NR resource grid]] 是 5G NR 中以 frequency-domain subcarriers 與 time-domain [[OFDM symbol]]s 組成的 resource mapping grid；[[NR Frame Structure]] 在 resource grid 段落定義 [[Resource Element]]、[[Resource Block]] 與 [[Point-A]]。

NR resource grid › Resource Element
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- [[Resource Element]] is the unit of a single subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and on one antenna port。

因此 RE 是 frequency、time 與 antenna port 三個維度上的最小 grid unit。

NR resource grid › 與 CSI-RS / DMRS 的關係
既有 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] 頁面已收錄 [[CSI-RS]] 與 [[Demodulation Reference Signals (DMRS)]] 對 TS 38.211 的引用。這些 reference signal 的 resource mapping 都需要 RE / RB / OFDM symbol 的 grid vocabulary。

本頁只補充 [[NR Frame Structure]] 來源中的 grid 基礎定義，不重述 DMRS 或 CSI-RS mapping tables。

5G NR numerology › 與 cyclic prefix 的關係
[[NR cyclic prefix]] 的來源表格列出：

- [[Normal CP]]：μ=0、1、2、3、4 皆列於來源表格，使用 14 OFDM symbols per slot。
- [[Extended CP]]：來源明示 NR Release 15 only defined for μ=2，使用 12 OFDM symbols per slot。

5G NR numerology
[[5G NR numerology]] 是 5G NR 中以 μ 表示的 OFDM time-frequency resolution 參數，決定 [[Subcarrier Spacing]]、slot duration、subframe 中 slots 數量，以及 [[SSB]] required bandwidth。

5G NR numerology › 定義
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- Numerology μ defines the time-frequency resolution。
- μ 決定 [[OFDM symbol]] time duration 與 [[Subcarrier Spacing]]。
- NR reference SCS μ=0 是 15 kHz，來源說與 LTE 相同。
- μ 越高，time resolution 越高。
- μ 越高，frequency resolution 越低。

5G NR frame structure › OFDM symbols per slot
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- [[Normal CP]] 使用 14 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- [[Extended CP]] 使用 12 [[OFDM symbol]]s per slot。
- 來源明示在 NR Release 15 中，[[Extended CP]] only defined for numerology μ=2。

5G NR frame structure › 與 resource grid 的關係
Frame / subframe / slot / symbol 是 time-domain structure；[[NR resource grid]] 則把 time-domain [[OFDM symbol]] 與 frequency-domain subcarriers 組成 grid。

- [[Resource Element]] 是 one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and on one antenna port。
- [[Resource Block]] 是 12 consecutive subcarriers。
- [[Point-A]] 是 resource grid starts toward higher frequencies 的 frequency-domain reference。

OFDM, as described here, is the waveform/resource structure in which time-domain OFDM symbols and frequency-domain subcarriers form the 5G NR resource grid; a Resource Element is one subcarrier in one OFDM symbol on one antenna port [26][27].
In an OFDM system, a cyclic prefix is added to each time-domain OFDM symbol by copying the last samples of the raw OFDM symbol to its front, creating a guard interval to reduce inter-symbol interference [18].
NR numerology μ determines OFDM symbol duration and subcarrier spacing, and the sample rate is NFFT × SCS = NFFT × 2^μ × 15 kHz [31][23].
| Decision area | Product / option decision | Why OFDM matters | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| WLAN OFDM production/RF testing | On R&S CMW100 K06, choose WLAN generator/analyzer options for OFDM standards: CMW-KW650 for IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n OFDM generation; CMW-KM650/KM651/KM655/KM656/KM657 for WLAN OFDM RF analyzer coverage across 802.11a/g/n/p/ac/ax; choose analyzer bandwidth by standard and MIMO mode/options such as CMW-KM652 or CMW-KM653 [35]. | These options are explicitly for WLAN OFDM generation/analyzers, so the user must understand OFDM standards, bandwidths, and MIMO measurement modes when selecting them [35]. | [35] |
| 5G NR FR1 uplink TX measurement | On R&S CMX500, R&S CMX-KM600 is required for any NR FR1 uplink TX tests; supported measurements include multi-evaluation, PRACH, SRS, and TPC, with NR channel bandwidth 3 MHz to 100 MHz and FDD/TDD, NR standalone, and intraband contiguous EN-DC analysis [13]. | 【推論】Because 5G NR resource mapping is organized by OFDM symbols and subcarriers, and NR numerology determines OFDM symbol duration and SCS, selecting CMX-KM600 measurement settings such as SCS, bandwidth, and uplink signal analysis depends on OFDM concepts [26][31][13]. | [13][26][31] |
| 5G NR generator/analyzer option selection | CMX500 ordering lists R&S CMX-KM600 as the 5G NR analyzer and R&S CMX-KW601 as the 5G NR generator; CMX-KM600 analyzer conditions include FR1, SCS 30 kHz, 16QAM, and 100 MHz bandwidth EVM, while CMX-KW601 generator conditions include 5G NR PDSCH, full allocation, SCS 30 kHz/60 kHz, 64QAM, and 100 MHz bandwidth EVM [12][13]. | 【推論】Because SCS, OFDM symbol duration, and sample rate are coupled in NR OFDM, decisions about CMX500 NR analyzer/generator configuration rely on understanding OFDM numerology and waveform sampling [31][23][13]. | [12][13][31][23] |
| PC-based 5G NR / O-RAN signal analysis | R&S VSE is Rohde & Schwarz PC signal analysis software used for 5G NR, LTE, O-RAN U-Plane/PCAP analysis, and beamforming measurements; listed options include VSE-K144 for 5G-NR DL/UL measurements, VSE-K146 for 5G-NR MIMO & beamforming DL measurements, and VSE-K175 for O-RAN measurements [5][61]. | 【推論】Because 5G NR measurements use the OFDM resource grid and numerology, interpreting VSE 5G NR DL/UL and beamforming measurements depends on understanding OFDM symbols, subcarriers, and SCS [5][61][26][31]. | [5][61][26][31] |

R&S CMX500 › NR FR1
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，R&S CMX-KM600 是 frequency range 1 對 NR uplink signals 執行任何 TX tests 的必要 option。NR FR1 uplink measurements 包含 multi-evaluation、PRACH、SRS、TPC measurement。Multi-evaluation 支援 NR channel bandwidth **3 MHz 到 100 MHz**，可分析 FDD 與 TDD signals、NR standalone signals 與 intraband contiguous EN-DC signals。

NR cyclic prefix › 基本概念
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- 在 OFDM system 中，CP is added for each OFDM symbol in time-domain。
- CP 是把 raw OFDM symbol 最後幾個 samples 複製到 raw OFDM symbol 前方。
- CP provides a guard interval between two OFDM symbols。
- CP 用於 eliminate inter-symbol interference, ISI。
- NR defines two types of cyclic prefix lengths：[[Normal CP]] 與 [[Extended CP]]。

NR sample rate › Sample rate 公式
來源給出的 NR sample rate calculation：

- Sampling rate in samples/sec = number of samples per raw OFDM symbol / duration of one raw OFDM symbol。
- Sampling rate = NFFT / (1 / SCS)。
- Sampling rate = NFFT × SCS。
- SCS = 2^μ × 15 kHz。
- 因此 sampling rate = NFFT × 2^μ × 15 kHz。

NR resource grid
[[NR resource grid]] 是 5G NR 中以 frequency-domain subcarriers 與 time-domain [[OFDM symbol]]s 組成的 resource mapping grid；[[NR Frame Structure]] 在 resource grid 段落定義 [[Resource Element]]、[[Resource Block]] 與 [[Point-A]]。

NR resource grid › Resource Element
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- [[Resource Element]] is the unit of a single subcarrier in one OFDM symbol and on one antenna port。

因此 RE 是 frequency、time 與 antenna port 三個維度上的最小 grid unit。

5G NR numerology › 定義
依 [[NR Frame Structure]]：

- Numerology μ defines the time-frequency resolution。
- μ 決定 [[OFDM symbol]] time duration 與 [[Subcarrier Spacing]]。
- NR reference SCS μ=0 是 15 kHz，來源說與 LTE 相同。
- μ 越高，time resolution 越高。
- μ 越高，frequency resolution 越低。
